name: PoolableObject
src_typeComment: Optional companion to ObjectPool: gives pooled objects lifecycle events and a self-release timer. Adding this is optional — ObjectPool works fine on plain prefabs without it.

src_serialized.name: autoReleaseDelay
src_serialized.tooltip: If greater than 0, this object automatically releases itself back to its pool after this many seconds. 0 = stays until manually released.

src_members.name: SourcePool
src_members.comment: Assigned by ObjectPool when this instance is created; lets the object release itself without holding a manual reference.

src_members.sig: public bool IsPooled { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsPooled
src_members.comment: True while this instance is sitting inactive in its pool. ObjectPool checks this to reject a double-release (e.g. two different scripts both calling Release() on the same object), which would otherwise push the same instance into the pool twice and let two later Get() calls hand out the same live object.

src_members.name: Release
src_members.comment: Manual release call, e.g. an enemy calling this on death instead of Destroy(gameObject).
